tasks.description: Review independently a new full-organism numerical transport adapter. Check whether it conserves physical event histories, changing sensory buffers, model identities and fine-reference tolerances before interpreting odor-induced yaw. Examine actual source and saved arrays; distinguish numerical transport from biological stage3 admission.

Implement and run a local CUDA/C++ adapter for the existing 166700-neuron model and MuJoCo body. Preserve original state ownership, export full hidden-state results and repair concrete runtime integration failures without fitting biological parameters.

Compare three rival causal explanations using actual whole-organism traces: sensory contrast loss, basal-state dominance, and descending-readout/body mismatch. Determine the first interface where information or its effect is lost and design one bounded falsifying intervention without choosing gains to force correct yaw.
